status: Static pinned-source findings; native state effects not yet measured. No completed-study credit.

findings.evidence: Winning request stores agent ID and priority only. Sugar and metabolism local variables remain initialized to -1. Destination stores sugar=-1+cell_sugar and metabolism=-1; the request message carries original values but they are never read here.
findings.interpretation: This does not preserve agent wealth/metabolism on successful movement. Replaying archived population alone cannot validate those state variables.
findings.native_validation_required: Track agent IDs and metabolic values before and after actual successful moves; confirm observed state changes without modifying model rules.

findings.evidence: Benchmark uses wrap(x,y), whose default radius is1. Pinned iterator visits the square neighborhood except the origin, including diagonals. A separate vn_wrap API exists but is unused.
findings.interpretation: Eight-neighbor search differs from the four cardinal directions stated in the paper.
findings.native_validation_required: Track actual diagonal moves by stable agent ID, accounting for toroidal boundaries and multiple conflict rounds.

findings.evidence: After subtracting metabolism, source removes agents only when sugar_level==0. Paper describes removal when wealth is not positive.
findings.interpretation: Negative wealth is not caught by this condition. Occurrence and consequences are unmeasured, especially given the movement transfer issue.
findings.native_validation_required: Count active agents with negative wealth and trace mortality from pre-step state; do not infer occurrence from the predicate alone.

findings.evidence: Hotspot separation wraps distances across the torus. Sugar influence instead uses direct coordinate differences.
findings.interpretation: The implementation uses two distance conventions. The paper equation does not explicitly define its norm across boundaries, so this remains a specification question.
findings.native_validation_required: Reconstruct the exact initialized landscape from recorded hotspots and inspect boundary cells; compare any toroidal alternative as a separately labeled sensitivity.

constraints: Wait until the original full benchmark is terminal; do not overlap GPU work.
Keep source rules and random draws unchanged; passive population snapshots only.
Require all100 population observations to match the unmodified qualification prefix.
Audit unique agent IDs, valid statuses, wealth, metabolism, and position changes.
Exclude observer timings from performance comparisons.
Do not silently correct any finding in the historical replay.
